plugins.name: sa-skills
plugins.description: Architecture documentation for Claude Code — creates and maintains ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/, its component index, explorer headers and release lifecycle, with every gate as code. Installs sa-records (ADRs, TDRs), sa-requirements (PO Spec, capability alignment), sa-analysis (risk analyses, traceability), sa-delivery (handoff kit, Word export, IcePanel sync, MCP index) and sa-visualization (the 3D command center with Alia) — 15 skills in the suite. An organization adds its own standards through an institution pack.

plugins.name: sa-records
plugins.description: Decision and debt records on their own: ADRs (including an institutional ADR catalog in catalog mode) and TDRs. A dependency of sa-skills; install it alone for a catalog repository.

plugins.name: sa-requirements
plugins.description: Product Owner requirements on their own: elicit, score and write the Product Owner Specification, and align it to a capability framework — BIAN for banking, a cross-industry capability map, or an institution pack's — before any architecture exists. A dependency of sa-skills; install it alone for a Product Owner.

plugins.name: sa-analysis
plugins.description: Checks over a written architecture: ten risk and design-characteristics analyses plus the consolidated Security Posture, and the PO Spec coverage report. Reads the architecture through sa-skills; a dependency of sa-skills.

plugins.name: sa-delivery
plugins.description: Artifacts handed to other teams and tools: the development handoff kit with validated API and data contracts, Word exports, the IcePanel C4 sync and the architecture MCP index. Reads the architecture through sa-skills; a dependency of sa-skills.

plugins.name: sa-visualization
plugins.description: Interactive views of the architecture: the 3D Architecture Command Center with Alia the navigator, findings on the stage, the load simulation and photo mode, as one HTML file. Reads the architecture through sa-skills; a dependency of sa-skills.

plugins.name: sa-ux
plugins.description: Optional UX layer for a solution architect working with sa-skills: Claude Code mods that draw the architecture's state — next steps computed from the project's files, as numbered prompts above the prompt box. Reads what the skills write; never edits an architecture document. Needs a Claude Code build with function-hook mods.
